summary: One OTD mode on the Re = 180 periodic orbit, with the base flow advanced by the DNS. Its exponent is that of the phase mode, zero.

produced.mode: userParam01=5.1 (base flow advanced by the DNS), lpert = 1, white-noise start, endTime = 260 (50 periods)

description: The expected value is the largest Floquet exponent of the Re = 180 Newton orbit of 210_baseflow_newton: the phase mode, multiplier 1, exponent 0 (311_stability_direct_floquet gives 3.4e-6), not a value read back from an OTD run. The exponent of the single OTD mode in the last period (t = 254.3 to 259.5) was 6.7e-6. It is a transient before that: it was -0.133 in the first period, +0.04 around t = 70 and -0.24 around t = 166, and it first stays below 1e-4 in absolute value at t = 197 (period 38).
